_what: The ROUTES.md blocked-item high-water mark: open, carrying no DEFAULT, 3+ days old.
_why: Failing outright on all of these would put the build red for weeks and get switched off — intervention-rate already wrote that epitaph ('a guard that cries wolf every morning is a guard that gets switched off'). So the check fails only when this number GROWS. The backlog cannot get worse silently.
_how_to_lower: When routes_response_check.js reports fewer, lower this number in the same commit that earned it. A ratchet nobody tightens is just a high-water mark.
_gaming_signature: `blocked` can fall because items were ANSWERED or because a DEFAULT was bolted on. Answering raises `answered`; bolting on defaults does not. A fall in blocked with no rise in answered is reported, not failed — a lane may legitimately let a batch proceed on their defaults, but that is a decision and must be visible rather than silent.
